entries.name: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot
entries.description: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot is used to enumerate processes, threads, and modules. This function is commonly used by malware to enumerate processes before process injection.

entries.name: EnumDeviceDrivers
entries.description: EnumDeviceDrivers is used to enumerate drivers in the machine. This function is commonly used with kernel malware or for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: EnumProcesses
entries.description: EnumProcesses is used to enumerate processes in the machine. Process enumeration is often a precursor to process injection.

entries.name: EnumProcessModules
entries.description: EnumProcessModules is used to enumerate the loaded modules (executables and DLLs) for a given process. Malware enumerates through modules when doing injection.

entries.name: EnumProcessModulesEx
entries.description: EnumProcessModulesEx is used to enumerate the loaded modules (executables and DLLs) for a given process. Malware enumerates through modules when doing injection.

entries.name: FindFirstFileA
entries.description: FindFirstFileA is used to search through a directory and enumerate the filesystem.

entries.name: FindNextFileA
entries.description: FindNextFileA is used to search through a directory and enumerate the filesystem.

entries.name: GetLogicalProcessorInformation
entries.description: GetLogicalProcessorInformation is used to retrieve information about logical processors and related hardware. The function is used by malware for anti-debugging purposes.

entries.name: GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx
entries.description: GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx is used to retrieve information about logical processors and related hardware. The function is used by malware for anti-debugging purposes.

entries.name: GetModuleBaseNameA
entries.description: GetModuleBaseNameA is used to retrieve the base name of a specified module.

entries.name: GetSystemDefaultLangId
entries.description: GetSystemDefaultLangId is used to retrieve the language identifier for the system. This function is used by malware that wish to infect specific locales or simply wish to gather statistics on areas of infection.

entries.name: GetVersionExA
entries.description: GetVersionExA is a classic method used to retrieve the Windows version.

entries.name: GetWindowsDirectoryA
entries.description: GetWindowsDirectoryA is used to retreive the path to the Windows directory. This function may be used by malware retrieve the Windows path for additional installations.

entries.name: IsWoW64Process
entries.description: IsWow64Process is used by a 32-bit process to determine if it is running on a 64-bit operating system.

entries.name: Module32First
entries.description: Module32First is used as part of CreateToolHelp32Snapshot for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: Module32Next
entries.description: Module32Next is used as part of CreateToolHelp32Snapshot for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: Process32First
entries.description: Process32First is used as part of CreateToolhelp32Snapshot for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: Process32Next
entries.description: Process32Next is used as part of CreateToolhelp32Snapshot for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: ReadProcessMemory
entries.description: ReadProcessMemory can be used to read the memory of a remote process.

entries.name: Thread32First
entries.description: Thread32First is used as part of CreateToolhelp32Snapshot for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: Thread32Next
entries.description: Thread32Next is used as part of CreateToolhelp32Snapshot for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: GetSystemDirectoryA
entries.description: GetSystemDirectoryA retrieve the path of the system directory.

entries.name: GetSystemTime
entries.description: GetSystemTime is used to retrieve the current system date and time in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) format. This function is commonly used by malware for anti-debugging.

entries.name: GetComputerNameA
entries.description: GetComputerNameA is used to retrieve the computer name. This is commonly used by malware for anti-debugging purposes.

entries.name: VirtualQueryEx
entries.description: VirtualQueryEx is used to retrieve information about a range of pages within the virtual address space of a specified process. This function is commonly used by malware to enumerate an external process.

entries.name: GetProcessIdOfThread
entries.description: GetProcessIdOfThread is used to retrieve the process identifier of the process associated with the specified thread.

entries.name: GetProcessId
entries.description: GetProcessId is used to retrieve the process identifier of the specified process.

entries.name: GetCurrentThread
entries.description: GetCurrentThread is used to retrieve a handle for the calling thread.

entries.name: GetCurrentThreadId
entries.description: GetCurrentThreadId is used to retrieve the thread identifier of the calling thread.

entries.name: GetThreadId
entries.description: GetThreadId is used to retrieve the thread identifier of the specified thread.

entries.name: GetThreadInformation
entries.description: GetThreadInformation is used to retrieve information about the specified thread.

entries.name: GetCurrentProcess
entries.description: GetCurrentProcess is used to retrieve a handle for the current process.

entries.name: GetCurrentProcessId
entries.description: GetCurrentProcessId is used to retrieve the process identifier of the calling process.

entries.name: SearchPathA
entries.description: SearchPathA is used to search for a specified file in a specified path.

entries.name: GetFileTime
entries.description: GetFileTime is used to retrieve the date and time that a file or directory was created, last accessed, and last modified.

entries.name: GetFileAttributesA
entries.description: GetFileAttributesA is used to retrieve file system attributes for a specified file or directory.

entries.name: LookupPrivilegeValueA
entries.description: LookupPrivilegeValueA is used to retrieve the locally unique identifier (LUID) used on a specified system to locally represent the specified privilege name. This function is commonly used by malware in process injection or token stealing.

entries.name: LookupAccountNameA
entries.description: LookupAccountNameA is used to accept the name of a system and an account as input. It retrieves a security identifier (SID) for the account and the name of the domain on which the account was found.

entries.name: GetUserNameA
entries.description: GetUserNameA is used to retrieve the username associated with the current thread. This function is used by malware for anti-debugging purposes.

entries.name: RegEnumValueA
entries.description: RegEnumValueA is used to enumerate the values for the specified open registry key

entries.name: RegQueryInfoKeyA
entries.description: RegQueryInfoKeyA is used to retrieves information about the specified registry key.

entries.name: NtQueryDirectoryFile
entries.description: NtQueryDirectoryFile is used to retrieve information about a directory. This function can be used for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: EnumDesktopWindows
entries.description: EnumDesktopWindows is used to enumerate all top-level windows associated with the specified desktop. This function is commonly used for enumeration purposes.

entries.name: NetShareEnum
entries.description: NetShareEnum is used to retrieve information about each shared resource on a server.

entries.name: NetShareGetInfo
entries.description: NetShareGetInfo is used to retrieves information about a particular shared resource on a server.

entries.name: PathFileExistsA
entries.description: PathFileExistsA is used to determine whether a path to a file system object such as a file or folder is valid. This function is used by malware to enumerate files and installed programs (e.g. AV solutions).

entries.name: GetIpNetTable
entries.description: The GetIpNetTable function retrieves the IPv4 to physical address mapping table. Could be used to identify hosts & mounted drives tracking ARP entries.

entries.name: GetLogicalDrives
entries.description: GetLogicalDrives is used to retrieve a bitmask representing the currently available disk drives. This function can be used to emumerate all drives / mounted drives.

entries.name: RegEnumKeyA
entries.description: RegEnumKeyA is used to enumerate the subkeys of the specified open registry key. The function retrieves the name of one subkey each time it is called.

entries.name: FindNextUrlCacheEntryA
entries.description: FindNextUrlCacheEntryA is used to retrieve the next entry in the Internet cache.

entries.name: WNetAddConnectionA
entries.description: The WNetAddConnectionA function enables the calling application to connect a local device to a network resource. A successful connection is persistent, meaning that the system automatically restores the connection during subsequent logon operations.

entries.name: EnumResourceTypesA
entries.description: EnumResourceTypesA is used to enumerate resource types within a binary module. Starting with Windows Vista, this is typically a language-neutral Portable Executable (LN file), and the enumeration also includes resources from one of the corresponding language-specific resource files (.mui files)â€”if one existsâ€”that contain localizable language resources. It is also possible to use hModule to specify a .mui file, in which case only that file is searched for resource types. Alternately, applications can call EnumResourceTypesEx, which provides more precise control over which resource files to

entries.name: GetSystemTimeAsFileTime
entries.description: Retrieves the current system date and time. The information is in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) format. This function is commonly used by malware for anti-debugging.

entries.name: CreateFileMappingA
entries.description: CreateFileMappingA creates a handle to a file mapping that loads a file into memory and makes it accessible via memory addresses. Launchers, loaders, and injectors use this function to read and modify PE files.

entries.name: CreateRemoteThreadEx
entries.description: CreateRemoteThreadEx is used to create a thread that runs in the virtual address space of another process.

entries.name: GetModuleHandleA
entries.description: GetModuleHandleW is used to retrieve a module handle for the specified module. The module must have been loaded by the calling process. This function is often used along with GetProcAddress to dynamically retrieve the address of a function for evasion purposes.

entries.name: HeapCreate
entries.description: HeapCreate is used to allocate heap memory that can be used by the calling process.

entries.name: LocalAlloc
entries.description: LocalAlloc is used for heap allocation and manipulation.

entries.name: MapViewOfFile
entries.description: MapViewOfFile is used for heap allocation and manipulation.

entries.name: MapViewOfFile2
entries.description: MapViewOfFile2 is used for heap allocation and manipulation.

entries.name: OpenThread
entries.description: OpenThread is used to get a handle on a specified thread. It is commonly seen in process injection techniques.

entries.name: SetProcessDEPPolicy
entries.description: SetProcessDEPPolicy is used to override the default DEP policy. Malware will use this function to allow data execution.

entries.name: SetThreadContext
entries.description: SetThreadContext is used to modify a thread's context. This is often used as part of process injection techniques.

entries.name: Toolhelp32ReadProcessMemory
entries.description: Toolhelp32ReadProcessMemory can be used to read the memory of other processes.

entries.name: VirtualProtectEx
entries.description: VirtualProtectEx is often used by malware to modify memory protection in a remote process (often to allow write or execution).

entries.name: VirtualAllocExNuma
entries.description: VirtualAllocExNuma is used to reserve or changes the state of a region of pages in the virtual address space of a specified process.

entries.name: VirtualAlloc2
entries.description: VirtualAlloc2 is used to reserve or changes the state of a region of pages in the virtual address space of a specified process.

entries.name: VirtualAllocFromApp
entries.description: VirtualAllocFromApp is used to reserve or changes the state of a region of pages in the virtual address space of the calling process.

entries.name: WaitForSingleObject
entries.description: WaitForSingleObject is used to delay the execution of an object. This function is commonly used to allow time for shellcode being executed within a thread to run. It is also used for time-based evasion.

entries.name: GetProcessHeap
entries.description: GetProcessHeap is used to retrieve a handle to the default heap of the calling process.

entries.name: GetProcessHeaps
entries.description: GetProcessHeaps is used to return the number of active heaps and retrieves handles to all of the active heaps for the calling process.

entries.name: HeapReAlloc
entries.description: HeapReAlloc is used to reallocate a block of memory from a heap.

entries.name: CreateProcessAsUserA
entries.description: CreateProcessAsUserA is used to create a new process and its primary thread.

entries.name: OpenProcessToken
entries.description: OpenProcessToken is used to open the access token associated with a process.

entries.name: NtAdjustPrivilegesToken
entries.description: NtAdjustPrivilegesToken is used to modify state of avaiable token's privileges. This function is often used by malware that performs process injection often calls this function to gain additional permissions.

entries.name: NtCreateProcess
entries.description: NtCreateProcess is used to create a new process.

entries.name: NtCreateSection
entries.description: NtCreateSection is used to create a new section object.

entries.name: NtCreateThread
entries.description: NtCreateThread is used to create a new thread.

entries.name: NtDuplicateObject
entries.description: NtDuplicateObject is used to create a handle that is a duplicate of the specified source handle. Malware can use this function to obtain the necessary access rights to a process via duplicating its handle, and subsequently kill a process or inject into it.

entries.name: NtOpenThread
entries.description: NtOpenThread is used to get a handle on a thread. This function is commonly used as part of process injection.

entries.name: NtProtectVirtualMemory
entries.description: NtProtectVirtualMemory is used to interact with and modify memory regions.

entries.name: NtQueueApcThreadEx
entries.description: NtQueueApcThreadEx is used to execute code for a different thread. This function is commonly used as part of process injection.

entries.name: NtUnmapViewOfSection
entries.description: NtUnmapViewOfSection is used to unmap a view of a section from the virtual address space of a subject process.

entries.name: NtWaitForSingleObject
entries.description: NtWaitForSingleObject is used to wait until the specified object is in the signaled state or the time-out interval elapses. This function is commonly used by malware for evasion purposes.

entries.name: NtWriteVirtualMemory
entries.description: NtWriteVirtualMemory is used to copy the specified address range from the current process into the specified address range of the specified process.

entries.name: LdrLoadDll
entries.description: LdrLoadDll is used instead of LoadLibrary to load modules.

entries.name: SetPropA
entries.description: SetPropA is used to add a new entry or changes an existing entry in the property list of the specified window. This function is commonly used by malware to register a property and wait for its invocation to execute malicious commands.

entries.name: WaitForMultipleObjectsEx
entries.description: WaitForMultipleObjectsEx is used to wait until one or all of the specified objects are in the signaled state or the time-out interval elapses. This function is commonly used to allow time for shellcode to execute or for time-based evasion.

entries.name: KeInsertQueueApc
entries.description: KeInsertQueueApc is responsible for attaching an initialized APC to the APC queue of its target thread

entries.name: NtSuspendProcess
entries.description: NtSuspendProcess is used to suspend the target process

entries.name: NtReadVirtualMemoryEx
entries.description: NtReadVirtualMemoryEx is used to copy data in the specified address range from the address space of the specified process into the specified buffer of the current process

entries.name: DebugActiveProcessStop
entries.description: DebugActiveProcessStop stops the debugger from debugging the specified process.

entries.name: DeleteFileA
entries.description: DeleteFileA is used to delete an existing file. This function is used by malware to hide its tracks or tamper with an application.

entries.name: SetFileTime
entries.description: SetFileTime sets the date and time that the specified file or directory was created, last accessed, or last modified. This function is often used by malware to conceal malicious activity.

entries.name: SetFileAttributesA
entries.description: SetFileAttributesA is used to set attributes of a file or directory. This function is commonly used by malware to make a file or directory hidden.

entries.name: SleepEx
entries.description: SleepEx is used to suspend the execution of the current thread for a set time. This function is commonly used for time-based evasion by adding delays in the code.

entries.name: CreateWindowExA
entries.description: CreateWindowExA is used to create an overlapped, pop-up, or child window with an extended window style. This function is commonly used by malware to create invisible windows or for evasion purposes.

entries.name: IcmpSendEcho
entries.description: IcmpSendEcho is used to send an IPv4 ICMP echo request and returns any echo response replies. The call returns when the time-out has expired or the reply buffer is filled. This function is used by malware for time-evasion purposes by specifying a large timeout value.

entries.name: CreateWaitableTimer
entries.description: CreateWaitableTimer is used to create a delay timer. This function is used by malware for time-based evasion.

entries.name: SetTimer
entries.description: SetTimer is used to create a timer with the specified time-out value. This function is commonly used by malware for time-based evasion

entries.name: ImpersonateLoggedOnUser
entries.description: The ImpersonateLoggedOnUser function lets the calling thread impersonate the security context of a logged-on user. The user is represented by a token handle.

entries.name: LockResource
entries.description: LockResource is used with FindResource(), LoadResource() and SizeOfResource() usually to work with embedded executables into the .rsrc section (droppers)

entries.name: CryptProtectData
entries.description: CryptProtectData can be leveraged to create a malicious artifact for encrypting the file system (Ransomware), effectively evading typical detection methods. More information is available: https://github.com/CarlosG13/Data-Protection-API-DPAPI-For-Impact---Ransomware

entries.name: CallNextHookEx
entries.description: CallNextHookEx is used within code that is hooking an event set by SetWindowsHookEx. CallNextHookEx calls the next hook in the chain. This function is commonly used by keyloggers.

entries.name: GetClipboardData
entries.description: GetClipboardData is used to retrieve copied data residing in the clipboard.

entries.name: GetKeyboardState
entries.description: GetKeyboardState is used to copy the status of the 256 virtual keys to the specified buffer. This function is commonly used by keyloggers.

entries.name: GetMessageA
entries.description: GetMessageA is used to retrieve a message from the calling thread's message queue. This function is commonly used by keyloggers.

entries.name: GetRawInputData
entries.description: GetRawInputData is used to retrieve the raw input data from a specified device. This function is commonly used by keyloggers.

entries.name: MapVirtualKeyA
entries.description: MapVirtualKeyA is used to map a virtual-key code into a scan code or character value, or translates a scan code into a virtual-key code. This function is commonly used by spyware and keyloggers.

entries.name: PostMessageA
entries.description: PostMessageA is used to post a message in the message queue associated with the thread that created the specified window and returns without waiting for the thread to process the message.

entries.name: PostThreadMessageA
entries.description: PostThreadMessageA is used to post a message to the message queue of the specified thread.

entries.name: SendMessageA
entries.description: SendMessageA is used to send the specified message to a window or windows.

entries.name: SendNotifyMessageA
entries.description: SendNotifyMessageA is used to send the specified message to a window or windows.

entries.name: UnhookWindowsHookEx
entries.description: UnhookWindowsHookEx is used to remove a hook procedure installed in a hook chain by the SetWindowsHookEx function.

entries.name: BitBlt
entries.description: BitBlt is used to copy graphic data from one device to another. Spyware sometimes uses this function to capture screenshots.

entries.name: GetKeynameTextA
entries.description: The GetKeynameTextA function is used to retrieve a string that represents the name of a key.

entries.name: HttpOpenRequestA
entries.description: HttpOpenRequestA is used to create a HTTP request.

entries.name: HttpSendRequestExA
entries.description: HttpSendRequestExA is used to send a HTTP request to a server

entries.name: InternetCloseHandle
entries.description: InternetCloseHandle is used to close an internet handle.

entries.name: InternetReadFile
entries.description: InternetReadFile is used to read data from a handle opened by the InternetOpenUrl, FtpOpenFile, or HttpOpenRequest function.

entries.name: URLDownloadToFile
entries.description: URLDownloadToFile is used to download bits from the Internet and saves them to a file.

entries.name: URLDownloadToCacheFile
entries.description: URLDownloadToCacheFile is used to download data to the Internet cache and returns the file name of the cache location for retrieving the bits.

entries.name: URLOpenStream
entries.description: URLOpenStream is used to create a push type stream object from a URL.

entries.name: Connect
entries.description: Connect is used to establish a connection to a specified socket.

entries.name: Inet_addr
entries.description: inet_addr is used to convert a string containing an IPv4 dotted-decimal address into a proper address for the IN_ADDR structure.

entries.name: Recv
entries.description: Recv is used to receive data from a connected socket or a bound connectionless socket.

entries.name: Gethostname
entries.description: gethostname is used to retrieve the standard host name for the local computer.

entries.name: WSACleanup
entries.description: WSACleanup is used to terminate the use of the Winsock 2 DLL. This function is commonly used by malware upon successfully utilizing the Winsock 2 functions.

entries.name: Listen
entries.description: Listen is used to place a socket in a state in which it is listening for an incoming connection.

entries.name: DnsQuery_A
entries.description: DnsQuery_A is used to send a DNS query. This may be used for communications over a DNS tunnel.

entries.name: InternetConnectA
entries.description: InternetConnectA is used to open a File Transfer Protocol (FTP) or HTTP session for a given site.

entries.name: WSASocketA
entries.description: WSASocketA is used to create a socket that is bound to a specific transport-service provider.

entries.name: Closesocket
entries.description: Closesocket is used to close an existing socket.

entries.name: HttpAddRequestHeaders
entries.description: HttpAddRequestHeaders adds HTTP request headers to forge custom request handle

entries.name: CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent
entries.description: CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent is used to check if a debugger is being used. This function is commonly used by malware for anti-debugging techniques.

entries.name: ExitWindowsEx
entries.description: ExitWindowsEx is used to log off an interactive user, shuts down the system, or shuts down and restarts the system. This function is commonly used by malware as an anti-debugging technique.

entries.name: FindWindowA
entries.description: FindWindowA is used to get a handle to the top-level window whose class name and window name match the specified strings. This function is commonly used by malware as an anti-debugging technique.

entries.name: QueryPerformanceFrequency
entries.description: QueryPerformanceFrequency is used to retrieve the frequency of the performance counter. This function is commonly used by malware for anti-debugging purposes. The malware will measure the time before and after an operation, if the time exceeds taken expected time, the malware will terminate or activate a benign function.

entries.name: CountClipboardFormats
entries.description: CountClipboardFormats is used to determine whether victim's clipboard was empty. A kind of Anti-debugging technique to determine if the system could be a sandbox.

entries.name: EncryptFileA
entries.description: EncryptFileA is used to encrypt a file or directory.

entries.name: CryptDecrypt
entries.description: CryptDecrypt is used to decrypt data.

entries.name: CryptDeriveKey
entries.description: CryptDeriveKey is used to create encryption keys.

entries.name: CryptGetHashParam
entries.description: CryptGetHashParam

entries.name: CryptGenRandom
entries.description: CryptGenRandom is used to fill a buffer with cryptographically random bytes.

entries.name: FlushEfsCache
entries.description: FlushEfsCache is used to flush EFS data from memory. This is used by EFS ransomware post-encryption to cause the files and folder to become unreadable.

entries.name: CryptReleaseContext
entries.description: The CryptReleaseContext function is used to release the handle of a cryptographic service provider (CSP) and a key container.

entries.name: ConnectNamedPipe
entries.description: ConnectNamedPipe is used to create a server pipe for interprocess communication that will wait for a client pipe to connect. This function can be used to simplify connectivity to a C2 server.

entries.name: CreateFileA
entries.description: CreateFileA is used to create a new file or opens an existing file.

entries.name: CreateMutexExA
entries.description: CreateMutexExA is used to create a new mutex object. Mutexs are often used by malware to prevent the reinfection of a system with the same or different malware variant.

entries.name: FindResourceExA
entries.description: FindResourceExA is used to find a resource in an executable or loaded DLL. Malware sometimes uses resources to store strings, configuration information, or other malicious files. If you see this function used, check for a .rsrc section in the malware’s PE header.

entries.name: GetModuleFileNameExA
entries.description: GetModuleFileNameExA is used to return the filename of a module that is loaded in the current process. Malware can use this function to modify or copy files in the currently running process.

entries.name: GetTempPathA
entries.description: GetTempPathA is used to retrieve the path of the directory designated for temporary files. This is often used by malware when it requires a location for additional installations.

entries.name: PeekNamedPipe
entries.description: Used to copy data from a named pipe without removing data from the pipe. This function has been used by exploits targeting SMB vulnerabilities.

entries.name: CopyFile2
entries.description: CopyFile2 is used to copy an existing file to a new file.

entries.name: CreateFile2
entries.description: CreateFile2 is used to create a new file or opens an existing file.

entries.name: GetTempFileNameA
entries.description: GetTempFileNameA is used to create a name for a temporary file. If a unique file name is generated, an empty file is created and the handle to it is released; otherwise, only a file name is generated.

entries.name: SetCurrentDirectory
entries.description: SetCurrentDirectory is used to change the current directory for the current process.

entries.name: FindClose
entries.description: FindClose is used to close a file search handle.

entries.name: SetThreadPriority
entries.description: SetThreadPriority is used to set the priority value for the specified thread. This value, together with the priority class of the thread's process, determines the thread's base priority level.

entries.name: UnmapViewOfFile
entries.description: UnmapViewOfFile is used to unmap a mapped view of a file from the calling process's address space.

entries.name: ControlService
entries.description: ControlService is used to start, stop, modify, or send a signal to a running service. This function is commonly used by malware went it requires interaction with a service for malicious purposes.

entries.name: ControlServiceExA
entries.description: ControlServiceExA is used to start, stop, modify, or send a signal to a running service. This function is commonly used by malware went it requires interaction with a service for malicious purposes.

entries.name: CreateServiceA
entries.description: CreateServiceA is used to create a service object and adds it to the specified service control manager database. This function is commonly used by malware for persistence.

entries.name: DeleteService
entries.description: DeleteService is used to mark the specified service for deletion from the service control manager database.

entries.name: OpenSCManagerA
entries.description: OpenSCManagerA is used to open a handle to the service control manager. This function is commonly used when a malware intends to interact with a service.

entries.name: OpenServiceA
entries.description: OpenServiceA is used to open an existing service.

entries.name: RegOpenKeyA
entries.description: RegOpenKeyA is used to open a specified registry key.

entries.name: RegOpenKeyExA
entries.description: RegOpenKeyExA is used to open a specified registry key.

entries.name: StartServiceA
entries.description: StartServiceA is used to start a service.

entries.name: RegCreateKeyA
entries.description: RegCreateKeyA is used to create a specified registry key. If the key already exists, the function opens it.

entries.name: RegSetValueExA
entries.description: RegSetValueExA is used to set a value and type for a given registry key.

entries.name: RegDeleteValueA
entries.description: RegDeleteValueA is used to remove a named value from the specified registry key.

entries.name: RegLoadKeyA
entries.description: RegLoadKeyA is used to create a subkey under HKEY_USERS or HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE and loads the data from the specified registry hive into that subkey.

entries.name: RegLoadMUIStringA
entries.description: RegLoadMUIStringA is used to load the specified string from the specified key and subkey.

entries.name: RegOpenCurrentUser
entries.description: RegOpenCurrentUser is used to retrieve a handle to the HKEY_CURRENT_USER key for the user the current thread is impersonating.

entries.name: RegOverridePredefKey
entries.description: RegOverridePredefKey is used to map a predefined registry key to the specified registry key.

entries.name: RegSaveKeyA
entries.description: RegSaveKeyA is used to save the specified key and all of its subkeys and values to a registry file, in the specified format.

entries.name: RegSaveKeyExA
entries.description: RegSaveKeyExA is used to save the specified key and all of its subkeys and values to a registry file, in the specified format.

entries.name: RegConnectRegistryA
entries.description: RegConnectRegistryA is used to establish a connection to a predefined registry key on another computer.

entries.name: RegCreateKeyTransactedA
entries.description: RegCreateKeyTransactedA is used to create the specified registry key and associates it with a transaction. If the key already exists, the function opens it.

entries.name: RegDeleteKeyA
entries.description: RegDeleteKeyA is used to delete a subkey and its values from the specified platform-specific view of the registry.

entries.name: RegDeleteKeyTransactedA
entries.description: RegDeleteKeyTransactedA is used to delete a subkey and its values from the specified platform-specific view of the registry as a transacted operation.

entries.name: NtClose
entries.description: NtClose is used to close an open handle.

entries.name: NtDeleteKey
entries.description: NtDeleteKey is used to delete a registry key.

entries.name: NtDeleteValueKey
entries.description: NtDeleteValueKey is used to delete a registry key value.

entries.name: NtSetContextThread
entries.description: NtSetContextThread is used to set the usermode context of the specified thread.

entries.name: NtSetSystemEnvironmentValueEx
entries.description: NtSetSystemEnvironmentValueEx is used to set a system environment variable.

entries.name: NtTerminateProcess
entries.description: NtTerminateProcess is used to terminate a process and all its threads.

entries.name: NtTerminateThread
entries.description: NtTerminateThread is used to terminate a thread.

entries.name: DrawTextExA
entries.description: DrawTextExA is used to draw formatted text in the specified rectangle. This function has been used by ransomware for writing ransom notes.

entries.name: SetWindowLongA
entries.description: SetWindowLongA is used to changes an attribute of a specified window.

entries.name: OpenClipboard
entries.description: OpenClipboard is used to get a handle on the clipboard.

entries.name: SetForegroundWindow
entries.description: SetForegroundWindow is used for bring the thread that created the specified window into the foreground and activates the window

entries.name: ShowWindow
entries.description: ShowWindow is used to set the specified window's show state.

entries.name: NtQueryTimer
entries.description: NtQueryTimer is used to query a timer's attributes.

entries.name: CreatePipe
entries.description: CreatePipe is used to create an anonymous pipe and returns handles to the read and write ends of the pipe. Could be used to add a sub-process for execution via cmd.

entries.name: lstrcatA
